KaTeX 0.17.0 is vendored for offline card-view math rendering.
Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.17.0
License: MIT; see LICENSE in this directory.

Included files:
- katex.min.js / katex.min.css
- contrib/auto-render.min.js
- dist/fonts/* required by katex.min.css

Do not replace these files with CDN URLs: AI HUB must render formulas offline.
